[[Hajok Earthguardian (Insect)|Hajok Earthguardian]] is an [[Insect]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Yatendi Canyons]].

== Locations ==
* [[Vabbi]]
** {{NPC location|Yatendi Canyons}}

== Skills ==
(16 [[Earth Magic]], 20 [[Energy Storage]] in [[hard mode]])
* {{skill icon|Armor of Earth}}
* {{skill icon|Aura of Restoration}}
* {{skill icon|Master of Magic}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Stone Daggers}}
* {{skill icon|Stoning}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Chitin Fragment]]s
* [[Geode]]
* [[Hajok's Prism]] ([[Unique item|unique]])

== Notes ==
* In hard mode, Master of Magic does not increase nor decrease its rank 16 Earth Magic, since rank 20 Energy Storage causes Master of Magic to set elemental attribute ranks to 16.
* Elementalists capping Master of Magic may wish to bring a second [[Signet of Capture]], as an Elementalist boss with [[Invoke Lightning]] is in the area.

== Trivia ==
* In other languages his name is still Hajok Earthguardian without any translation.
